caption: The drawing depicts a high-backed armchair with winged sides, rendered in shades of deep red and burgundy, featuring subtle highlights and shadows that define its form and texture. The chair has solid armrests, and the seat and backrest are padded, all covered in the same reddish hue. The lower edge of the seat is bordered with a thin gold trim. The legs of the chair are ornate, carved in a cabriole style, with distinct wooden details shaded in darker brown tones. The chair sits on a wooden floor, shown in lighter brown and tan shades. There is a shadow cast beneath the chair, rendered in a gradient of gray and black. The background is a muted beige with light gray brushstrokes, and the entire scene is enclosed within two hand-drawn rectangular borders, one tight to the image and another closer to the edge of the drawing.
title: Wing Chair
